consent.heading: Consent for your child
consent.body: I am the parent or legal guardian of this learner driver. I agree that the driving school uses DriveOS to manage their lessons, progress, documents and payments, and that I can see this information, book and cancel lessons and pay for them. I can withdraw my consent at any time by contacting the school.
